name: GX-230D
description: "A 3-head tape deck equipped with a recording GX / erasure combination head and two reproducing GX heads.D-C-D (Direct Capstan Drive) is adopted for the mechanism part.In this system, the shaft for feeding the tape and the shaft of the motor for exclusive use of the capstan are integrated. This makes it possible to specialize the motor for driving the capstan, reducing noise and eliminating the need for a cooling fan, improving quietness. In addition, since the rubber belt can be eliminated, the wow flutter can be kept low, and wear and deterioration of the rubber belt can be prevented. In addition, by simplifying the structure, error factors such as eccentricity and roundness can be reduced, and more accurate rotation can be obtained without being affected by fluctuations in the power supply.The motor is composed of 3 motors.For the reel, it is equipped with 2 Eddy Current Outer Rotor Type Motors for reel, and supports speedy operation and overuse.The capstan motor is equipped with a C. P. G built-in pure-AC servo motor.This motor uses a C. P. G detection mechanism. C. P. G stands for Center Pole Frequency Generator. It has a structure in which the magnetic pole of the detection part is in the center and a flux path (magnetic path) is formed radially. Since 112 pulses are added simultaneously over the circumference of the frequency generator, the detection output is large, S/N is good, and it is stable.Since this frequency generator is built into the motor, eccentricity and eccentricity are minimized, and since it is not a rotating magnetic pole type as seen in other examples, there is no influence such as uneven magnetization.The structure of this motor is an outer rotor type. The rotor is made of a high-quality electromagnetic steel plate processed into a cup shape. As a result, there is no change in magnetic resistance around the circumference, and very smooth rotation is obtained. Moreover, the moment of inertia is large and stable.GX head is used for the head part.The GX head provides 16-20 dB less compensation in the high-frequency range than the conventional head, enabling high-level recording on the same tape.In addition, because of its ideal shape, the magnetic field is close to the focus state, making it possible to record more excellent sound.Both auto and manual reverse playback is possible.Sensing is a 1-point system. In order to take advantage of the D / C / D mechanism, the pinch roller is released from the capstan at the reverse point, and the capstan is clamped after the number of rotations becomes constant, so that the start-up is perfect.The impedance roller has a shape similar to a double capstan and maintains stable tape running while applying a moment of inertia to the tape.It is integrated with the flywheel inside, but it has a good balance design to take advantage of the start-up by the D / C / D mechanism.It has an output volume.The tape selector is a one touch type and can be set to the optimum values for the bias and equalizer.The pose button reuses the lock style.Equipped with a mixing mechanism of Line and Mic.Equipped with a large VU meter.It adopts a new design using 3 mm thick aluminum."

name: GX-266II
description: "This is an open deck with further improved performance and functions while maintaining the symmetrical mechanism established in the GX 266 d.A new CPG built-in AC servo motor is used for the capstan drive motor.This is a newly developed motor with a built-in sample-and-hold circuit that has excellent servo characteristics and virtually no motor vibration. It has excellent characteristics in all aspects such as high-frequency characteristics, distortion rate, abrasion resistance, and dust adhesion.The symmetrical mechanism, including a center capstan located at the center of the head block and six heads arranged symmetrically, realizes uniform recording and playback characteristics in both directions.The tape path by the center capstan, the one way dump tension arm, the logic circuit to control the tape movement, the unique polyester band brake and the mirror finish new GX head make the tape travel smooth.This makes it possible to use not only double-play tapes (200% type) but also ultra-thin triple-play tapes (300% type).Tape running mode can be switched to 3 stages of one way or one round trip recording / playback and repeat playback.It is equipped with a 2-position tape selector, the bias is fixed to the optimum value, and the circuit design adjusts the recording equalizer.Equipped with timing lamp auxiliary sound mute mechanism. name: GX-270D
description: "A 3-head tape deck equipped with a recording GX / erasure combination head and two reproducing GX heads.D-C-D (Direct Capstan Drive) is adopted for the mechanism part.In this system, the shaft for feeding the tape and the shaft of the motor for exclusive use of the capstan are integrated. This makes it possible to specialize the motor for driving the capstan, reducing noise and eliminating the need for a cooling fan, improving quietness. In addition, since the rubber belt can be eliminated, the wow flutter can be kept low, and wear and deterioration of the rubber belt can be prevented. In addition, by simplifying the structure, error factors such as eccentricity and roundness can be reduced, and more accurate rotation can be obtained without being affected by fluctuations in the power supply.The motor is composed of 3 motors.For the reel, it is equipped with 2 Eddy Current Outer Rotor Type Motors for reel, and supports speedy operation and overuse.The capstan motor is equipped with a C. P. G built-in pure-AC servo motor.This motor uses a C. P. G detection mechanism. C. P. G stands for Center Pole Frequency Generator. It has a structure in which the magnetic pole of the detection part is in the center and a flux path (magnetic path) is formed radially. Since 112 pulses are added simultaneously over the circumference of the frequency generator, the detection output is large, S/N is good, and it is stable.Since this frequency generator is built into the motor, eccentricity and eccentricity are minimized, and since it is not a rotating magnetic pole type as seen in other examples, there is no influence such as uneven magnetization.The structure of this motor is an outer rotor type. The rotor is made of a high-quality electromagnetic steel plate processed into a cup shape. As a result, there is no change in magnetic resistance around the circumference, and very smooth rotation is obtained. Moreover, the moment of inertia is large and stable.GX head is used for the head part.The GX head provides 16-20 dB less compensation in the high-frequency range than the conventional head, enabling high-level recording on the same tape.In addition, because of its ideal shape, the magnetic field is close to the focus state, making it possible to record more excellent sound.Both auto and manual reverse playback is possible.Sensing is a 1-point system. In order to take advantage of the D / C / D mechanism, the pinch roller is released from the capstan at the reverse point, and the capstan is clamped after the number of rotations becomes constant, so that the start-up is perfect.The impedance roller has a shape similar to a double capstan and maintains stable tape running while applying a moment of inertia to the tape.It is integrated with the flywheel inside, but it has a good balance design to take advantage of the start-up by the D / C / D mechanism.It has an output volume.The tape selector is a one touch type and can be set to the optimum values for the bias and equalizer.The pose button reuses the lock style.Equipped with a mixing mechanism of Line and Mic.Equipped with a large VU meter.It also has a peak level indicator that responds at plus 7 dB.It adopts a new design using 3 mm thick aluminum.Follow-up recording is possible.Remote Control Unit RC-17 (sold separately) allows recording of absence."

name: GX-280D.
description: "This 3-motor, 3-head stereo tape deck adopts a direct capstan drive motor with servo circuit and an GX head.We have adopted a newly designed direct capstan drive motor with servo circuit for capstan drive in pursuit of higher performance.It is designed to detect and amplify the motor speed purely electrically and compensate for changes in the rotational speed by means of a servo circuit, by integrating an Eddy Current Outer Rotor Motor, a control winding and a pulse generator for speed detection into an integrated structure. It is able to maintain a constant rotational speed at all times and achieves very stable tape running.In addition, belts, idlers, flywheels, etc. are layered, and the wow and flutter are held down by a simple mechanism.We have adopted two Eddy Current Outer Rotor Motors for driving both supply and take-up reels.Uses GX (Glass & X' Tal Ferrite) head.By applying crystal ferrite (single crystal ferrite) developed for VTR and various ultra-precision processing technologies for VTR head to audio head, this head uses single crystal ferrite with superior characteristics to conventionally used permalloy as core material for the first time in the world. In addition, the periphery including gap is hardened with glass.The surface of this head is made of glass and crystal ferrite, so that dust does not adhere to it and it does not wear. Moreover, the ""focused field"" provides excellent frequency characteristics.In addition, there is no need to replace or clean the head, and it has a Longraima which is 100 times larger than the conventional permalloy head.Equipped with auto stop / auto shut-off function.When the tape is fully wound and reaches the end, the automatic shut-off lever will stop the tape from running.When the auto shut-off switch is pressed, the power of the whole unit is turned off when the shut-off lever is returned.You can use S. R. T. tape (Super Range Tape).By pressing the S. R. T. button, you can demonstrate the performance of a low-noise tape.Sound-on-sound recording is possible, and it is possible to record one person duet making use of language, practice of musical instrument performance and double recording.In addition, since the microphone and line inputs are independent, mixing recording is possible.Equipped with a direct function change mechanism that automatically enters the selected mode simply by pressing the Play or Reverse button in the fast-forward / rewind state."

name: GX-285D
description: "A high-grade stereo tape deck GX-280D with a Dolby NR system.The head uses Akai's characteristic Glass & Single Crystal GX head (GX head).A unique single crystal is used for the core material of the GX head, and the whole is wrapped in ultra-hard glass.The single crystal is made of a single crystal and has excellent electromagnetic conversion efficiency and high-frequency characteristics because there is no gap inside the core compared with permalloy and general ferrite. In addition, S/N has been improved compared with permalloy and general ferrite by reducing noise.In addition, since it has excellent abrasion resistance, it can be precisely processed into a narrow gap and the gap depth can be made shallow. This realizes the best head touch and sharp focus magnetic field (focus field).These features make it possible to reduce the high-frequency loss due to the excellent magnetic characteristics, reduce the compensation amount of the equalizer on the recording amplifier side to compensate for the loss of the head, and enable high-level recording by the increase of dynamic margin especially during recording.Equipped with a Dolby system to reduce tape noise.The principle is that when recording on tape, when the input signal is only in a range lower than a certain level, or when the overall volume is small and noise is conspicuous, the volume is automatically increased with emphasis on the high range and the overall volume difference is compressed.Then, during playback, it automatically reduces by the augmented amount to return to the original balance, which reduces noise by the restored amount.A direct capstan drive system has been adopted for the tape running system.The outer rotor motor, control winding and speed detection gear are integrated into an integrated structure, and an AC servo control motor is mounted, which is designed to detect motor speed purely electrically and compensate for changes in rotational speed by electromagnetic brake using servo circuit and frequency oscillator. Thus, constant rotational speed is maintained without being affected by fluctuations in power supply voltage or power supply frequency.In addition, two 6-pole eddy current outer rotor motors are used for the reel drive, providing excellent driving characteristics.It is equipped with a tape switching switch. When using a low-noise tape, it can be set to S. R. T to show its characteristics.Equipped with a monitor switch, you can compare the sound before and after recording simply by switching the monitor switch alternately between Source and Tape.Line recording level control and microphone recording level control are installed independently.The sound-on-Sound system allows you to enjoy multiple performances by one person or overlapping recordings, the Sound-with-Sound system is convenient for language and instrument training, and the Line-microphone input mixing recording is available.Equipped with a direct function change system, you can record, play back, fast forward, rewind, and stop all with one touch operation. You do not need to press the stop button every time you switch.Equipped with an automatic stop mechanism that automatically stops the reel rotation at the end of the tape.It also comes with a convenient automatic shut-off feature that automatically shuts off the entire unit.Equipped with a 4-digit index counter.Equipped with a pause button that allows you to temporarily stop the tape running during recording and playback."

name: X-200D
description: "Auto-reverse deck with 3-motor configuration and cross field head.Cross-field head is used for the head part.In the conventional recording method, a signal current and a bias current current were applied to the recording head at the same time. However, due to the influence of a wide bias magnetic field, the recorded signal is erased or weakened. This phenomenon was particularly noticeable at high frequencies.To solve this problem, the cross-field method uses a recording head for the signal current and an external bias head for the bias current. By placing these heads at relatively displaced spatial positions, the signal recorded on the tape is not adversely affected by the bias magnetic field.Permanent reverse by sensing tape is possible.When the sensing tape is inserted in the middle of the tape to be used, it automatically rotates in the reverse direction when it touches the sensing pin while the tape is running. By attaching the sensing tape to the tape (coating surface) at point A and attaching it to the backing surface of the tape at point B, reverse playback between points A and B is possible.Manual reverse is also possible. If you press the reverse button in the middle of the tape, you can switch the performance in the reverse direction.Two ICs developed by Akai are used in the preamplifier section.A 3-motor configuration is used for the mechanism part.A hysteresis synchronous 3 motor is used for the capstan drive.It uses a 2-lever system to ensure reliable operation and robustness.Slide-type recording level control is used.The track selector allows easy switching between stereo and monaural.Automatic stop, automatic shut-off, automatic pinch roller I'm using a release.Equipped with a tape lifter that works for fast forward and rewind.The exterior uses a walnut finish."

name: ST-100
description: "ST series 2-way speaker system.The ST Series has an acoustic filter in the low-frequency unit.This acoustic filter works to cut out medium - and high-frequency distortion that cannot be removed only by the electrical network on the input side, thereby cutting out signals and distortion outside the network band that are output as sound on the output side.In addition, by developing a unique acoustic filter that can obtain the same characteristics as a large loss without using a loss material that causes damping noise, distortion that could not be removed in the past has been removed.The low range has a 16 cm cone woofer with an acoustic filter on the front.This unit uses a special edge to reduce the minimum resonant frequency by calculating a balance with the mass of the edge.A 3.1 cm dome-shaped tweeter is installed in the high range.The diaphragm is not made larger than necessary, and the unit size is adopted in consideration of the balance with directivity. By this, the voice coil diameter is larger than the area of the diaphragm, and stable piston vibration is possible.A level control is provided for the high-frequency band.We have adopted a closed-type enclosure that uses both homogen and lauan materials.Considering the balance with the unit, the front and rear baffles are 15 mm thick and the sides are 12 mm thick. name: CD-A70
description: "A CD player developed with the aim of Akai's ideal CD player.Anti-resonance construction has been developed and installed with an emphasis on vibration control of the player itself.First of all, the cabinet top cover is made of a composite damping steel sheet with antiresonance new metal sandwiched between metal steel plates made of a unique polymer material. Compared with ordinary steel plates, this steel plate is less susceptible to vibration and has extremely short damping characteristics.The insulator uses a new material, anti-resonance special rubber with excellent vibration damping characteristics to absorb external vibrations.In addition, it employs a double-insulated floating mechanism that combines rubber and spring and mechanically insulates the entire mechanical block, including the optical system and drive system, from the main body. Comparatively high-frequency vibrations are absorbed by spring, and low-frequency vibration components are absorbed by special rubber.The power supply section has been strengthened, and the digital and analog systems, including the servo circuit, have been made independent of the power transformer winding, and the rectifier circuit has been adopted as a separate power supply. In addition, the amplifier and D/A converter of the analog rectifier circuit have been made independent of each other. This eliminates the power supply from the digital circuit and the contamination of harmful components such as noise.In addition, since the power supply space is related to the sense of volume in the low frequency range, two specially designed 2,200 Ï‰ F electrolytic capacitors are used for both digital and analog current supply circuits. These capacitors damp squeals and use paints that do not contain metal components to achieve non-magnetic properties.The servo circuit is equipped with a new servo control system that normally applies relatively light servo control to prevent reading errors due to scratches or dust, and that only strengthens servo control when trace errors are likely to occur due to unexpected external vibration.As a result, traceability is greatly improved and large fluctuations in servo amount are suppressed.A digital filter with an attenuation of 90 dB has been developed and installed. Sharp attenuation characteristics and almost flat group delay characteristics in the audio band are obtained.After the digital filter is inserted a 7th order low-distortion low-pass filter with a gentle curve to remove residual components. This filter uses a coil (high-core type) with low squeal and a copper foil styrofoam capacitor with excellent hearing test results to prevent sound quality degradation.In addition, parts such as copper foil Styrofoam capacitors, metal-coated resistors, and high-speed Bi-FET operational amplifiers are used in critical parts of de-emphasis circuits and analog circuits.It is equipped with It's Logic function which is AKAI's original programming mechanism.This is a unique program that combines the 10 key with the three keys And, To, and Without. For example, if you want to play the first to sixth songs except the fourth song on the disc, press the key 1To6 Without 4.This program can be programmed up to 27 steps with one key operation as one step.It is equipped with functions such as music search, index search, 2-way speed manual search, section (A Ï‰ B) repeat, program skip play, etc.Subcode terminal is mounted.Equipped with a headphone port with volume.Wireless remote control is included."

name: A
description: "A CD player developed in pursuit of the ideal form of a CD player, reproducing music signals with extreme precision, and thoroughly seeking high sound quality and high quality.To prevent interference between digital and analog circuits, analog and digital circuits are completely separated from the power supply to the circuit board.In addition, the analog circuit board is separated by a shield case made of copper-plated steel plate, and the digital circuit board adopts double-sided circuit board to strengthen the shield to reduce unnecessary radiation.The digital circuit is equipped with a 4 x over-sampling 18-bit precision 266 order digital filter that increases the sampling frequency by a factor of 4 and eliminates sampling noise. name: AM-A70
description: "Integrated amplifier equipped with open loop circuit.It is equipped with an open loop circuit that pursues simplicity without relying on NFB.This circuit eliminates the overall NFB loop, the basic configuration of the amplifier is simple with only two stages : a voltage stage (V amplifier) and a current stage (I amplifier), and a parallel push-pull two stage Darlington configuration with two power transistors per channel.The AM-A70 incorporates a discrete open-loop circuit for the phono equalizer amplifier and main amplifier. In addition, AKAI's own 0 drive circuit is inserted between the V amplifier and the I amplifier to improve low-impedance drive capability and circuit stability with a 2-pole DC servo amplifier connected to all stages.In a simple circuit, the characteristics of the elements appear in the sound as they are, so we use parts carefully selected through thorough hearing tests. We also use transistors, capacitors, and resistors that give excellent sound quality results.In particular, the use of electrolytic capacitors has been reduced to one third of that of conventional amplifiers in order to reduce the deterioration of sound quality caused by capacitors. Although the equalizer amplifier and V amplifier use independent constant-voltage power supplies, there are only two electrolytic capacitors for smoothing, including this power supply. The I amplifier also has only two electrolytic capacitors except for the protective circuit.AS-1 for audio is used for the electrolytic capacitor, and fast recovery diode is used for the rectifier circuit for V amplifier / I amplifier.In addition, high-resolution FBET (folded electrode transistor) is used for the output stage of the V amplifier and the drive stage of power devices, and metalized polyester film capacitors made by Raderstein (ERO) of Germany are used for the DC servo circuit.In addition, FBET uses a copper heat sink to reduce vibration, and electrolytic capacitors use non-magnetic paint to improve sound quality.Equipped with a line straight-through switch, you can jump the tone control circuit.The input / output terminal for video is mounted.A buffer amplifier is installed on the video connector to reduce noise.Equipped with a REC selector that can be used independently of the input selector.Equipped with a 2-channel speaker selector switch.Equipped with MC cartridge selector switch.Equipped with a -20dB muting circuit.Equipped with a subsonic filter and loudness.Aluminum front panel is used for the front panel.Gold plated terminals with excellent conductivity and aging resistance are used for all input / output terminals.Uses a oxygen-free copper power cord with polarity indication."

name: A
description: "Integrated amplifier with digital input.As a countermeasure against digital noise, a digital noise reduction structure has been developed and adopted in the DA-U7000.The digital circuit uses an active PLL circuit.The input digital signal is demodulated before it is input to the D/A converter and synchronized with the D/A converter. For this purpose, PLL circuits and crystal oscillators are used, but each of them has its own advantages and disadvantages. The PLL circuit is inferior in temperature characteristics and tends to be out of sync when synchronizing in a wide range. Crystal oscillators can achieve accurate synchronization, but on the other hand, they overlap with the oscillation of the PLL and become a powerful digital noise source, which adversely affects the analog section.The active PLL circuit used in the DA-U7000 uses a crystal oscillator to synchronize with the digital signal first, and after locking, the operation is stopped and the signal is held reliably by the PLL circuit. The PLL circuit is integrated into a single chip together with a voltage control oscillator (VCO) to improve temperature characteristics and reduce unnecessary radiation.Moreover, when an analog signal is input, unnecessary digital circuits are stopped to prevent excessive digital noise.The D/A converter is an independent D/A converter for the left and right.The digital filter is equipped with a 16-bit 4 x oversampling digital filter.The D/A converter section has a dual shield structure.In this structure, the circuit is strictly shielded, and the case itself is also floating from the amplifier chassis to shut out external noise from the ground line.The structure prevents noise from the D/A converter from leaking outside.In the power supply section, the power supplies for the digital and analog sections are completely separated from the rectifier circuit to the circuit board. In addition, constant-voltage power supplies are arranged independently in a total of 11 locations, including for driving D/A converters and for lighting LEDs, to eliminate interference from digital noise.The constant voltage power supply uses a reference constant current with a light-emitting diode to produce a constant voltage with less noise and to refine the sound quality.In the analog amplifier section, the circuit boards of the current amplifier stage (I amplifier) and the voltage amplifier stage (V amplifier) are completely separated, so that the influence of magnetic force due to large current from the I amplifier to the V amplifier is suppressed.Super active power supply is used for the power supply for the amplifier.Normally, current is supplied instantaneously from the rectifier diode to the capacitor of the power supply section. However, with the super active power supply, this supply time is approximately three times longer. Moreover, by supplementing this with the DC power supply, a constantly stable, pure and loose constant voltage is supplied from the preamplifier of the amplifier circuit to the drive stage of the power amplifier.The amplifier circuit is equipped with a new open loop circuit unique to A & D that removes the overall NFB loop.The open-loop circuit does not have an NFB that returns from output to input. The basic amplifier configuration is simple with only two stages of V and I amplifiers. Each stage is a completely symmetrical cascade non-feedback amplifier, and the bare characteristics are polished to the utmost.In addition, the input stage of the open loop circuit does not use a general differential input, but adopts a simple circuit configuration of perfectly symmetrical parallel in / push-pull out, and suppresses even order harmonic distortion.Digital input is equipped with one optical system and coaxial Route 3.Two coaxial digital outputs are provided.The sampling frequency is 48 kHz, 44.1 kHz and 32 kHz.Both digital and analog sources are equipped with independent direct operation switches, and all sources can be connected directly to the power amplifier.Equipped with a muting switch.Uses high-quality parts carefully selected in the hearing test.A large insulator is adopted as a measure against vibration from the outside.Uses gold-plated terminal.The power cable is a oxygen-free copper power cable with polarity indication."

LR-independent type, which, together with the low-pass filter-off function that enables recording with a higher freshness of the source, enables faithful recording.The reproduction system is equipped with a 4-times oversampling digital filter, making it possible to lower the analog filter and realizing excellent phase linearity and frequency characteristics.In addition, the D/A converter is equipped with an LR independent type glitch less high-speed D/A converter.The rotary (rotary) head uses a sputtering Sendust head developed by A & D that realizes high sound quality and high durability.The transport mechanism is equipped with five motors for capstan, drum, reel, mechanical drive, and tape mounting.In particular, the newly developed high-torque DD capstan motor has been adopted for the capstan motor to maintain excellent rotational characteristics over a long period of time.The tape loading uses a linear skating system that realizes comfortable operation, and in addition, the double-cushion 4-point cassette half support guarantees reliable tape mounting.In order to completely eliminate the interference between analog and digital, which causes degradation of sound quality, a complete separate construction is adopted.In addition to completely separating the analog and digital circuit boards, the analog section is completely sealed and shielded to completely prevent the pulse signal of the digital circuit from flowing into the analog circuit.Analog / digital independent winding transformer 6 power supply configuration is adopted in order to description: "This is a Quick Reverse Stereo Cassette Deck with 0.3 second quick reverse achieved by original technology such as infrared tape sensor.When the magnetic tape ends and the next reader tape passes through, the infrared tape sensor installed just before the recording / reproducing head detects the reader tape, and the reverse mechanism operates immediately.This method greatly reduces the sound gap to 0.3 seconds, enabling smooth reverse playback.A bi-counter capstan drive system is employed to achieve uniform tape running characteristics in both normal and reverse directions.In this system, dedicated capstan shafts and pinch rollers are provided on the outward and return paths, respectively, so that uniform characteristics can be maintained in both directions, and at the same time, good start-up is possible when the tape is reversed.In order to improve sound quality both on the outward and homeward routes, we have thoroughly reviewed the tape travel mechanism. We have adopted a unique travel mechanism that separates the tape guide from the head and further widens the contact surface between the tape guide and the tape.Infrared tape sensors and erasing heads also serve as tape guides, eliminating tape deflection and uneven crimping at the head that directly affect sound quality.Equipped with a reverse selector, recording / re-recording, one round trip recording / re-recording, continuous playback, etc. can be selected according to the adjusted position.It is equipped with Dolby NR system which suppresses the hissing peculiar to tape.Equipped with a 4-position tape selector, you can select the appropriate bias and equalizer for each tape.The input circuits for microphone and line are independent, and each can be selected with a selector.For line recording, the SN ratio is improved because the line input is sent directly to the recording amplifier without going through the microphone amplifier.Equipped with an output volume that can adjust the volume of headphones.It is equipped with a peak level indicator that responds quickly at + 7 dB to large instantaneous input signals that cannot be detected by VU meters alone.Built-in recording mute function.By combining the separately sold timer, it is possible to record the absence and play the alarm clock."

name: GX-7
description: "With the Super GX head at the core, this 3-head stereo cassette deck has improved sound quality, mechanism and functionality through DC amplifier, Dolby C, Double Capstan DD, and computer play.The head part is equipped with a 3-head system using AKAI's unique Super GX head which is well known.The performance of the Super GX head, which uses low-noise crystal ferrite as the head core material, boasting high magnetic permeability and high saturation magnetic flux density, is utilized by providing a head gap of 4 Ï‰ for recording and 1 Ï‰ for reproduction to improve various characteristics.With carefully selected devices, it is equipped with a DC amplifier with excellent sound quality, phase characteristics and dynamic range.In particular, the playback amplifier is composed of a first stage operation amplifier with dual FET and dual Tr and SEPP, and is directly coupled to the playback head to prevent deterioration of sound quality caused by the intervention of capacitors.In addition, a BI-FET operational amplifier with excellent linearity is used for the line amplifier, a high-speed IC operational amplifier is used for the recording amplifier, and a ¥2 power supply system is used for the power supply section. This is an amplifier configuration that emphasizes quality.As a noise reduction system, Dolby C type is installed in addition to Dolby B type.In the 1 kHz to 10 kHz band, the C-type has a noise reduction effect of 20 dB, which is approximately twice that of the B-type, and eliminates hissing below the audible level.In addition, by adopting a double-process system with a dedicated Dolby circuit for encoding and decoding, noise reduction effects can be confirmed for recording monitor characters.The mechanism uses a closed-loop double capstan system of distributed resonance type.Two sets of capstan and pinch rollers cut off disturbance components from the reel, improving wow and flutter characteristics. In addition, since the tape near the head is subjected to ideal intraloop tension, harmonic distortion caused by running is suppressed, and stable head touch is obtained at all times.The capstan drive uses AKAI's unique brushless coreless FG servo DD motor that provides high rotational accuracy and high torque.In addition, the tape travel performance has been improved by a unique tape guide system that expands the tape hold range, eliminates uneven crimping and eliminates level fluctuation and azimuth deviation, and a reel drive mechanism using a high-torque DC motor.Equipped with Akai's own quick and quiet mechanism.This is a system in which the setting of each operation mode is controlled by a microcomputer dedicated to system control and a motor, and it realizes an excellent response of 0.2 seconds at the start of play operation.It is equipped with direct lead-in. When the cassette half is set in the holder, it is loaded automatically just by pressing the desired operation button, and the operation is started as instructed.In addition, it is equipped with a power eject that releases the mechanism immediately by pressing the eject button even during play.It is equipped with a centralized display system using a large integrated FL tube so that the operation status of the deck can be seen at a glance.It is equipped with a REC cancel mechanism. When the switch is pressed, recording is stopped and automatically rewound to the interval between songs. After approximately 4 seconds of mute recording, it enters a recording standby state.Other than that, it is equipped with Introscan, IPLS (Automatic Heading) and memory autoplay function.Equipped with an auto tape selector, the tape position is automatically detected just by loading the tape, and the bias and equalizer are set to reference values.It is equipped with auto-mute, which is used as recording standby after 1-touch mute recording for approximately 4 seconds.Equipped with MPX filter switch to suppress 19 kHz pilot signal during air check.Equipped with a timer start mechanism.It can be operated from a remote location by the separately sold remote control."

name: GX-73
description: "A cassette deck with improved cost performance while inheriting the GX-93 technology.The GX-73 does not include the quartz PLL DD motor installed in the GX-93.Newly developed New Super GX head is adopted for the head.This head uses LC-OFC for the winding to reduce transmission distortion, which greatly improves resolution, especially for read heads with minute signal current levels.The core material of the Super GX head is ferrite crystallized by AKAI's unique manufacturing method. It has characteristics such as high permeability, high magnetic saturation point, low residual magnetism and low magnetization resistance. The gap is set optimally at 4 Ï‰ m for the recording head and 1 Ï‰ m for the reproducing head. In addition, the in-line accuracy of both channels and the parallelism between the recording / reproducing head gap are maintained with high accuracy. This is a combination of AKAI's advanced processing technologies.The mechanism uses a closed-loop double capstan system. In this system, the tape travel is strictly controlled by two capstan and pinch rollers, and the wow flutter is reduced by shutting out the disturbance from the reel. In addition, the tape span is short, the slight vibration of the tape can be controlled, and the tape tension is constant, so that stable head touch can be obtained.To make the most of the advantages of the closed-loop double capstan system, the capstan shaft diameter is made different between the take-up side and the supply side. Moreover, by changing the diameter of the flywheel, the overlap of the rotation cycle is eliminated. In addition, the tape guide, which is generally placed on the side of the head, is placed separately. Moreover, the contact surface with the tape is made wide R surface, and the dual-wide tape guide with a unique structure is adopted. name: GX-F66RC
description: "Quick Reverse Deck with Dolby C Type NR and multi-functional computer control design.Equipped with a quick reverse mechanism using an infrared tape sensor, it realizes quick tape reversal.A bi-counter capstan drive is used as the driving mechanism to ensure uniform driving characteristics in both directions.In this system, dedicated capstan shafts and pinch rollers are provided for each of the forward and reverse drives, and the recording and reproducing heads are designed to be symmetrical with respect to each other to ensure uniform driving characteristics.In addition, we have adopted our own high-precision tape guide to prevent tape deflection and uneven crimping at the recording / reproducing head, and moved the erasing head to the outside of the capstan for further stability.A unique twin field super GX head has been adopted for the recording / reproducing head.This head has a structure in which a recording gap and a reproducing gap are independently designed in a single head housing, thereby achieving the ideal of a head with a wide recording gap for optimum magnetic field and a narrow reproducing gap for detection of high-frequency magnetic signals.In addition, the core material is made of High and High Ï‰ ferrite materials, which have excellent magnetic permeability, high saturation magnetic flux density and dynamic characteristics. name: GX-F71
description: "This is a stereo cassette deck with improved sound quality, mechanism and operability by incorporating state-of-the-art technologies and harmonizing them at a high level.The head uses a 3-head system with Super GX head.Low-noise crystal ferrite with high magnetic permeability and high saturation magnetic flux density is used for the core, and excellent performance is also shown in mechanical secondary characteristics such as abrasion resistance and dust adhesion resistance.Equipped dolby C Type NR.The C-type has a higher noise reduction effect than the B-type, a sliding band method for suppressing bleeding (breathing of noise), spectral skewing for greatly improving high-frequency characteristics, and an anti-frequency circuit. The C-type features improved saturation characteristics in the high-frequency range, as well as measures against sound quality degradation.The recorder / re-amplifier is equipped with a ¥2 power source DC amplifier using carefully selected devices.The playback amplifier consists of a first stage differential amplifier and SEPP configuration with dual FET and dual transistor, and a direct coupling configuration to the playback head.In addition, the recording amplifier uses an IC operational amplifier with excellent linearity and the power supply section is reinforced to improve sound quality such as low distortion rate, wide dynamic range, and stable phase characteristics.The mechanism uses a closed-loop double-capstan transport mechanism and a direct-drive system to achieve high-precision tape travel.The two capstans firmly grip the tape in the head section and give a certain tension to the tape, which absorbs minute vibrations of the tape during driving and greatly reduces modulation noise.The capstan drive motor uses an FG servo DD motor that boasts high rotational accuracy and high torque to achieve low wow and flutter. In addition, the high torque DC-motor reel drive mechanism and unique tape guide are used to further enhance the quality of the drive system.It uses a quick and quiet mechanism in which a microcomputer controls the setting of each mode by controlling a dedicated motor.This minimizes the mechanism, and in addition, the head block is lifted up to the pose position even in the stop state, so that the start up speed during play operation is also faster.Equipped with an auto tape tuning mechanism.First, data is recorded and rerecorded with a 1 kHz reference signal, the level is coarsely adjusted, and the bias setting is started. The bias setting point is one step 3% and 32 steps. Rch is chosen as a representative, and the result of changing the bias from two directions is averaged. From shallow to deep gradually, from deep to shallow. On the other hand, from deep to shallow, from shallow to shallow. This method is highly accurate in that the point four steps over this average value is determined as the optimum bias value.Then, the equalizer and recording / resensitivity are adjusted based on the reference level of 1 kHz at three frequencies of 5 kHz, 7 kHz and 15 kHz to achieve a flat frequency response.This mechanism takes about 17 seconds, rewinds upon completion, and becomes a recording standby.In addition, this tuning data is automatically stored in the microcomputer for each tape position, and is equipped with a tuning-rec position. When recording with a timer, automatic tape tuning is performed before recording.It is equipped with a REC cancel mechanism. If you press this button when the recording timing is wrong, recording immediately stops, rewinds to between songs, and performs silent recording for for about 4 seconds and becomes recording standby.Equipped with an intro-scan function, if you press the FF and PLAY buttons at the same time, the head of the song from the next song to the end of the tape is automatically skipped and played for 10 seconds at a time.Equipped with IPLS (Automatic Heading) function, when the auto system switch is in IPLS mode and the FF or RWD button is pressed, the head of the next or current song is automatically found and play starts.In the memory counter mode, when RWD and PLAY are pressed simultaneously, the counter will rewind to the counter 0000 position and play will start automatically.It is equipped with an auto-fader. When the Fade button is pressed during recording standby, the recording level automatically fades in within 5 seconds. When the Fade button is pressed during recording, the recording automatically fades out. After 4 seconds of silent recording, the recording is switched to recording standby.Equipped with an auto monitor function, you can monitor the source side during recording standby and switch to the tape monitor side as soon as recording starts so that you can check the recorded music from your head.It is equipped with an auto mute function. If you press this button during recording, a silent recording is performed for 4 seconds and the recording standby mode is set.The Auto Tape Selector automatically detects the tape position just by loading, and simultaneously sets the bias and equalizer to the input reference values.Equipped with an FL bar meter with 18 segments in 2 colors for dual display of VU/PEAK switching.The scale can be switched between VU and PEAK to ensure reading of the level. There is also a tape position indicator on the meter to indicate the warning zone of the maximum recording input level.It is equipped with a timer start function that enables you to record messages and play an alarm clock."

name: GX-M30
description: "Metal tape compatible cassette deck with Super GX head.The newly developed twin field type Super GX combination head is adopted for the recording / reproducing head.This head uses newly developed High and High Ï‰ ferrite materials, and adopts a twin field structure for the first time in the world.The twin field structure functionally separates the two field systems of the recording field system and the reproducing field system. The recording gap is wide enough to handle metal tapes with high coercive force. The playback gap can also be set optimally to achieve excellent playback frequency characteristics. Like the GX head, it also has excellent secondary characteristics such as abrasion resistance and dust retention compared to metal heads such as permalloy and Sendust.A double-gap ferrite head using newly developed High ferrite material is used for the erasing head.It has high erasing efficiency and is compatible with metal tapes with high coercive force.It is equipped with IPLS (Instant Program Locating System) as an automatic cue function.In IPLS, the playhead detects the boundary between the signal and non-signal portions of the tape and automatically enters the play state by pressing the IPLS button and simultaneously pressing the RWD / FF lever and the PLAY lever.This function is activated when there is no signal for more than 4 seconds.Equipped with a 4-position tape selector, it can switch 4 positions of LN (low noise), LH (low noise high output), CrO2 (chrome or SA) and METAL to one touch.In addition, the bias fine adjustment knob is provided for each position, and the bias amount can be changed by ¥10% for each position.Equipped with a digital FL meter using a fluorescent display tube.This meter can be used as both a VU meter and a peak meter by switching the switch. The optimum recording level is estimated to be 0 dB for the VU meter and + 8 dB for the peak meter.The input circuit of microphone and line is independent, and mixing recording is possible.The line input goes directly to the line volume and the microphone input goes through the microphone amplifier and into the microphone volume, so that the line input does not pass through the microphone amplifier and does not pick up any excess noise.Equipped with auto-play function, it is possible to auto-play which automatically enters into regenerating condition at the tape end by pressing the RWD lever and Play lever simultaneously.It is also equipped with a memory play function so that you can listen repeatedly by setting the head of the song you want to listen repeatedly to the number 000 on the counter.It is equipped with a recording mute function, so you can make a silent recording part without changing the recording state.While this mechanism is in operation, the signal on the tape is not recorded, but the source can be monitored as is.Equipped with a Dolby NR system as a noise reduction system.Equipped with AKAI's own ADR system.In this method, the recording equalizer automatically adjusts according to the frequency band and level of the input signal to prevent distortion due to demagnetization in the high-frequency range. This makes it possible to record in the high-frequency dynamic range.Equipped with timer standby mechanism, recording of absence and alarm clock playback are possible by combining the timer.Equipped with electronic auto-stop mechanism.When the tape has finished running, the stop of the take-up reel is detected electronically and the STOP lever is released.It is equipped with a monomic mechanism. When one microphone is connected to the L-channel jack, the signal is automatically distributed to the R-channel as well, making it possible to use the center microphone for vocals."

name: GX-R6
description: "This is a quick reverse deck developed using Akai's traditional reverse technology and technology cultivated in Total Advanced Deck.The mechanism section is based on the bi-counter capstan drive-type driving mechanism that has been used in reverse decks, and is equipped with a bi-directional symmetrical precision (BSP) mechanism that pursues precision.Dedicated capstan shafts and pinch rollers are installed on the left and right sides of the head for forward and reverse respectively to realize a symmetrical tape travel system in which recording and re-recording conditions in both directions are identical.At the time of reverse operation, the pinch roller makes a seesaw movement, and the operation is reversed instantly. At the same time, the head rotates 180 degrees. In both directions, Lch/Rch is recorded and played back using the same head gap and amplifier.This allows for high-quality Oatley berth recording with little variation in reciprocating travel characteristics and recording / reconditioning, and with little noise blank feeling from the A side to the B side.The Accurate : Reverse Head System has been developed and installed in the head part, based on AKAI's accumulated technologies up to that time, and combined with the reliability of the rotary type.First of all, for the housing part which requires precision, we have adopted a zinc die-cast containing Beryllium, which shows 2 times the hardness and 8 times the abrasion resistance compared to ordinary zinc die-cast, and applied precision processing of Ï‰ order.The rotating parts are precisely coated with a solid lubricant mainly composed of fluorine resin, which has good sliding properties, to greatly reduce the coefficient of friction and improve durability.In addition, high hardness ceramic (purity 99% alumina) is adopted for the stopper part, and the impact caused by the rotation of the head is 100kg/cm.222,000kg/cm for2In addition, the azimuth adjustment screw that receives the stopper uses a fine screw that is hardened stainless steel. The elasticity of stainless steel absorbs the impact of rotation while eliminating wear.In addition, the loosening of adjustment screws, which is a problem in long-term use, is dealt with by the double nut method, and the return of the screws is locked.Moreover, in order to make the most of mechanical durability and reliability, a roll-up flexible printed board is adopted for the lead wire from the head to the amplifier, which had been a problem in conventional rotary type, and rotation failure due to disconnection and entanglement is prevented by winding it spirally at the head part.And, the rotation system adopts a double pinion drive with a dedicated motor that reliably operates in two gears.The tape guide is separated to the left and right from the head and has a wide contact surface with the tape. It uses Akai's unique dual-wide tape guide. This prevents azimuth deviation and tape curl caused by cassette half misalignment, and is combined with the BSP mechanism to further stabilize the tape running.A quiet mechanism driven by a dedicated cam motor controlled by a microcomputer controls mechanical sounds.The head is equipped with a Twin Field Super GX head, and 99.99% pure oxygen-free copper wire (OFC) is used for the coil wire to further improve the clearness of the sound quality.The Twinfield Super GX head has two head gaps for recording and playback in one head housing, giving it performance close to that of three heads. The characteristics have been further improved by improving the coil wire material.As a noise reduction system, in addition to the Dolby B type, it is equipped with the Dolby C type, which has a higher noise reduction effect.It is equipped with a blank search system, and with one touch, it finds unrecorded parts for more than 3 minutes, automatically rewind to the end point of the previously recorded music, mute recording for 4 seconds, and then it goes into recording standby.In addition, it is equipped with a REC cancel mechanism so that when you record a song or CM that you do not like by mistake, it can rewind to the beginning of the mistake recording with one touch, mute recording is done, and then it becomes recording standby.It is equipped with an intro-scan that skips the intros of recorded songs for 10 seconds with one touch.Equipped with IPLS (Automatic Head-Out) which finds the head of the next / current song with one touch.A newly developed electronic volume is used for recording level control.By using a microcomputer to change the volume, there is no volume noise due to aging degradation, and highly accurate control is possible.The number of steps is 16. It increases or decreases one step at a time with one touch, and it changes continuously by pressing and holding.Operation information such as 12-segment VU display bar meter, 4-digit electronic counter, REC level, reverse mode, type of noise reduction, tape position, travel direction, IPLS, REC mode, etc. is displayed centrally on the large 2-color FL tube for easy viewing.Equipped with an auto tape selector that can determine the type of tape just by setting it in the cassette half, an auto mute that allows one touch mute recording during recording, and a reverse mode selector that allows you to select one way rerecording / reciprocating rerecording / endless playback.GX-R6 is equipped with an output volume and MPX filter.Equipped with remote control mechanism and timer start mechanism, by connecting separately sold equipment, remote operation and timer recording can be performed."

name: GX-R55
description: "A quick reverse deck equipped with a twin field super GX head.The head section is equipped with a twin-field Super GX head with improved performance based on the Super GX head.A high-precision accurate reverse head system is used to reduce the azimuth deviation of the reverse deck.The reverse sound quality is enhanced by the BSP mechanism that matches the driving conditions in both forward and reverse directions, and the unique red dual-wide tape guide system.Uses a microcomputer controlled exclusive cam motor drive to realize a quick and quiet mechanism.An infrared tape sensor is used for quick reverse operation.The amplifier section is equipped with a high-tune DC amplifier.It is equipped with RPPS which can perform operations such as random music selection and intro play.The random selection mechanism allows you to program the songs you want to listen to in the order you want to listen to them.If you program up to 30 programs out of 29 songs on the A side and B side of the tape, the computer automatically controls and starts playing in the ordered sequence.Repeat playback is also available with this function.The Sequential Intro Play function plays the intro part of a song for 10 seconds and fast-forwards it to the beginning of the next song. name: GX-R60
description: "A cassette deck with improved cost performance by omitting some functions from the GX-R70.The GX-R60 omits the CRLP and the real-time display electronic digital tape counter that were installed in the GX-R70.Twin Field Super GX head is adopted for the head part.The Super GX Head uses ferrite, which has excellent electromagnetic conversion characteristics and moral development in the high-frequency band, as the head material. We have succeeded in making low-noise crystals by using our unique processing technology, realizing high permeability (High ?) and high saturation magnetic flux density (High) of ferrite. This low-noise crystal ferrite is used as the core material, and the whole is hardened with high-hardness glass.The Twin-Field Super GX Head adopts AKAI's unique twin-field structure in which recording gaps are provided independently in each head housing. Moreover, the recording gap is 4 microns to prevent magnetic saturation even when a deep bias current is applied, and the reproducing gap is 1 micron to ensure frequency characteristics up to ultra-high frequencies. By setting the optimum gap width, the recording / reproducing quality equivalent to that of a 3-head system is achieved.In addition, oxygen-free copper wire with a purity of 99.99% or more is used for the core winding to osae komi the generation of distortion due to capacitive reactances and to protect the purity of the minute current flowing in the head.In addition, it has excellent secondary characteristics such as abrasion resistance and dust adhesion resistance, and maintains high initial performance a long period of time.AKAI's proprietary accurate reverse head system is used for the reverse mechanism.In this mechanism, high-hardness zinc die-cast containing beryllium is adopted as the head housing material, and the head position is maintained with high precision by excellent characteristics such as 2 times the hardness and 8 times the abrasion resistance compared with ordinary zinc die-cast.The rotating part is coated with a smooth solid lubricant to a thickness of several microns to greatly reduce the friction coefficient and achieve smooth rotation.In addition, in order to maintain accurate azimuth system in both directions, stainless steel with high-hardness surface nitriding treatment is used for stopper, and loosening of adjustment screws, which becomes a problem in long-term use, is dealt with by double nut system.As for the rotation of the head, it is a double pinion drive in which the rack with especially low friction coefficient is quickly shifted to right and left by the motor drive, and a simple and complete rotation mechanism is realized.The Bi-directional Symmetrical Precision (BSP) mechanism is used for the mechanism part. In this method, the tape transport is almost perfectly symmetrical so that the reciprocating tape running characteristics can be made uniform.In addition, it is equipped with a dual-wide tape guide unique to AKAI. The contact surface with the tape is a wide R surface. The tape guide system that separates the left and right sides of the head increases the line strength of the tape edge. It accurately controls the tape running near the head, and the slight difference in the tape running characteristics between the round and the round is close to 0. In addition, it is able to cope with the variation of the cassette half that cannot be prevented by the normal tape guide that only adheres sheet metal to the side of the head. It also solves problems such as tape curl, track shift, azimuth shift, uneven head touch, and high tape.The Dolby B/C and dbx are installed as noise reduction systems.A high-tune DC amplifier is used for each of the recording and playback amplifiers. By eliminating the coupling capacitor, which causes sound quality degradation, the dynamic characteristics and resolution are greatly improved.In addition, the newly developed low-noise dual-FET input operational amplifier is used for the reproduction equalizer amplifier. Since this operational amplifier is capable of external phase compensation, it has excellent characteristics such as high slew rate, low distortion rate and low noise comparable to those of a discrete configuration.A differential input high-speed operational amplifier is used for the recording amplifier.We carefully select high-grade audio components, including high-resolution FBET (folded-electrode transistor), and use oxygen-free copper wires for wiring.The power supply employs a newly designed twin active power supply that is statically and dynamically stable against load fluctuations. Compared with conventional power supplies, this power supply has high-speed and high-equilibrium current control capability, and the dynamic characteristics of the amplifier are greatly improved.In addition, the power supply for the read / write amplifier and the Dolby circuit is separated, and the transformer winding and the rectifier are separated to eliminate interference.Equipped with a direct lead-in & power eject system.By simply setting the cassette half and pressing the desired operation button, the tape can be loaded automatically. In addition, the ejection is done by motor drive using Akai's original method.Equipped with auto-fader mechanism, fade in and fade out is possible with one touch.You can select 2 speeds, 3 seconds and 6 seconds.The FL display is adopted for the display part, and all information is displayed in a centralized manner.The bar meter is a 2-color 12-segment peak meter.Equipped with IPLS (Automatic Tracking Mechanism), you can track the next song or the song being played.Equipped with auto-mute mechanism, you can create a space between songs of about 4 seconds.Equipped with an auto tape selector that automatically detects the type of tape.Equipped with an MPX filter switch.Output volume is mounted.Equipped with a timer start mechanism.Equipped with a reverse selector to select the tape running mode.Gold plated terminals are used for the line input / output terminals.The power cable is marked with a white line on one side for easy polarity adjustment.There were Wired Remote Control RC-32 and Wireless Remote Control RC-92 as options sold separately."

name: Specifications
description: "Quick reverse deck equipped with dbx as noise reduction system.As a noise reduction system, it is equipped with dbx NR in addition to conventional Dolby B/C NR.With dbx, the level of the input signal is compressed to 1/2 for recording, and the level is expanded twice during playback. This method reduces the hissing inherent to tape by 30 to 40 dB and realizes a wide dynamic range.BSP (Bi-directional Symmetrical Precision) mechanism is adopted for the mechanism part.This mechanism is symmetrical in order to equalize the travel characteristics in both directions. Moreover, to stabilize the tape travel, the tape guide is made independent, and by installing a dual wide guide system with a wide tape contact surface, the disturbance of tape travel is reduced.In order to prevent the azimuth deviation due to the rotation of the head, a rotary system is adopted. The same head gap and read / write amplifier are used for both directions. On top of this, an accurate reverse head system with high accuracy and high reliability has been completed.High hardness zinc die-cast is used for the head housing part, solid lubricant with excellent abrasion resistance is used for the rotating part, and high hardness fine ceramics is used for the stopper part.Twin Field Super GX head is adopted for the head part.This head uses a single head housing with a recording head gap of 4 Ï‰ that can withstand deep bias current and a reproducing head gap of 1 Ï‰ that has good high-frequency characteristics. This achieves high performance equivalent to that of a 3-head.In addition, 99.99% pure oxygen-free copper wire (OFC) is newly used for coil wire to improve sound quality.The read / write amplifier is equipped with a ¥2 power source DC amplifier, and the Dolby block is independent of the amplifier block to avoid mutual influence.The amplifier section uses a high-slew rate low-noise OP amplifier and newly developed Fold Back Electrode Transistor (FBET) to increase the speed of the line amplifier and reduce distortion. description: "Stereo cassette deck with all front center control system.The mechanism uses a double independent drive system that drives the wind pulley and the flywheel separately.As a result, no unnecessary load is applied to the rotation of the capstan and stable tape travel is achieved.The head block adopts a newly developed linear motion mechanism that keeps the head block in a fixed position at all times, and realizes smooth operation without looseness.The cassette holder has a double-action (two step action) mechanism.With this mechanism, when the eject button is pressed, the cassette lid comes to the front and tilts greatly, making it easy to attach and detach the cassette. name: GXC-760D
description: "Stereo cassette deck composed of 3 heads and 3 motors.A 3-head configuration is used for the head part.The 3-head system, which can be used exclusively for recording and reproducing heads, can be designed to fully display the characteristics required for each head, enabling recording and reproduction taking full advantage of the performance of tape.Newly developed REC/PB combination GX head is used for the head.This head uses an ultra-narrow gap of 4 Ï‰ for the recording head gap and 1 Ï‰ for the reproducing head gap. In the 3-motor system, the capstan motor is used only for the rotation of the flywheel, and dedicated reel motors are used for the tape feeding and winding to stabilize the tape running.Closed-loop double capstan system is adopted for the mechanism.In this system, two pairs of pinch rollers and a capstan shaft cut off the tape feed and take-up sides to keep the tension in the loop constant at all times, prevent the tension from changing due to the tape winding diameter, and keep the touch of the tape to the head stable.For parts that make up the running diameter, such as capstan shafts, belts, flywheels and pinch rollers, attention has been paid to improve dimensional accuracy and eliminate machining errors, including 3 mm � capstan shafts with a mirror polished finish with a roundness error of 0.1 ?.The capstan motor uses a small-size CPG built-in AC servo motor, which has been used in AKAI's open reel decks, for use in cassettes. This minimizes runout in the detection part and ensures smooth rotation.A slotless DC motor is used for the reel motor.This motor has excellent durability with little cocking especially at low speeds. In addition, since the reel motor is directly connected to the reel shaft without using a belt or pulley, there is no characteristic change due to wear or deterioration of the belt.A double independent drive system has been adopted in which the capstan and reel stand are separately driven by a dedicated rubber belt, so that no unnecessary burden is imposed on the rotation of the capstan, and stable tape travel is achieved.A logic circuit is used in the system control section. description: "This is a quick reverse deck developed using Akai's traditional reverse technology and technology cultivated in Total Advanced Deck.Based on the GX-R6, the head has been changed and some functions have been omitted.The mechanism section is based on the bi-counter capstan drive-type driving mechanism that has been used in reverse decks, and is equipped with a bi-directional symmetrical precision (BSP) mechanism that pursues precision.Dedicated capstan shafts and pinch rollers are installed on the left and right sides of the head for forward and reverse respectively to realize a symmetrical tape travel system in which recording and re-recording conditions in both directions are identical.At the time of reverse operation, the pinch roller makes a seesaw movement, and the operation is reversed instantly. At the same time, the head rotates 180 degrees. In both directions, Lch/Rch is recorded and played back using the same head gap and amplifier.This allows for high-quality Oatley berth recording with little variation in reciprocating travel characteristics and recording / reconditioning, and with little noise blank feeling from the A side to the B side.The Accurate : Reverse Head System has been developed and installed in the head part, based on AKAI's accumulated technologies up to that time, and combined with the reliability of the rotary type.First of all, for the housing part which requires precision, we have adopted a zinc die-cast containing Beryllium, which shows 2 times the hardness and 8 times the abrasion resistance compared to ordinary zinc die-cast, and applied precision processing of Ï‰ order.The rotating parts are precisely coated with a solid lubricant mainly composed of fluorine resin, which has good sliding properties, to greatly reduce the coefficient of friction and improve durability.In addition, high hardness ceramic (purity 99% alumina) is adopted for the stopper part, and the impact caused by the rotation of the head is 100kg/cm.222,000kg/cm for2In addition, the azimuth adjustment screw that receives the stopper uses a fine screw that is hardened stainless steel. The elasticity of stainless steel absorbs the impact of rotation while eliminating wear.In addition, the loosening of adjustment screws, which is a problem in long-term use, is dealt with by the double nut method, and the return of the screws is locked.Moreover, in order to make the most of mechanical durability and reliability, a roll-up flexible printed board is adopted for the lead wire from the head to the amplifier, which had been a problem in conventional rotary type, and rotation failure due to disconnection and entanglement is prevented by winding it spirally at the head part.And, the rotation system adopts a double pinion drive with a dedicated motor that reliably operates in two gears.The tape guide is separated to the left and right from the head and has a wide contact surface with the tape.
